title: Getting Out of the Way of Something That Moves: Guessing Where It Is Going, Looking Along the Plan for the Moment They Meet, and Choosing Between Waiting and Going Round

artifact.note: an arm that shares its cell with something that moves: a track of the thing (its place and a velocity from successive sightings, smoothed), a prediction of where it will be, a look along the arm's planned trajectory for the first moment at which the arm's capsules and the predicted obstacle meet, and a run that follows the trajectory, stops when a meeting is predicted within a horizon, and then either waits for the thing to pass or plans again from where it stands (RRT-Connect and shortcutting, against the obstacle made a little larger) and goes on, with the monitor still looking along whatever plan it has
